items.title: Browse Subfolders
items.description: Choose View → Include Subfolders to see every image in a folder and its subfolders together. A collapsible folder tree filters by branch, and search finds images by name or path.

items.title: Text Without AI Insights
items.description: Read and copy the text in an image even when AI Insights is off or Apple Intelligence is unavailable. Recognized text stays available if a description fails.

items.title: Pick Up Where You Left Off
items.description: StillView reopens your last folder with the same image, sort order, subfolder setting, folder filter, and search.

items.title: Refresh Folder
items.description: Press ⌘R to pick up added, removed, or changed images without reopening the folder. Your selected image stays in place.

items.title: Clearer Image Insights
items.description: Descriptions are shorter and stick to what is visible. Tall documents and receipts get a higher-resolution text pass for better recognition.

items.title: Faster Grid Navigation
items.description: Up and Down arrows move by row in Grid, a visible outline marks the selection, and Return opens the selected image.

items.title: Smoother Large Folders
items.description: Images appear while a large folder is still being scanned, and thumbnails load with less memory.

items.title: Reliable Recent Folders
items.description: Recent folders keep their access permission, including folders on a drive that is temporarily disconnected.

items.title: Accurate Sort Labels
items.description: Sorting by creation time is now labeled Date Created, and the chosen sort applies after every folder load.
